items.title: Weakly etale morphisms of schemes compose, via flatness of iterated diagonals
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For morphisms X -> Y -> Z of schemes the lemma proves two statements: if the absolute-ish diagonals X -> X x_Y X and Y -> Y x_Z Y are flat then the diagonal X -> X x_Z X is flat, and consequently a composition of weakly etale morphisms is weakly etale. The retained proof is written: part (1) factors the diagonal of X over Z as X -> X x_Y X -> X x_Z X, identifies X x_Y X as the fibre product (X x_Z X) x_{Y x_Z Y} Y so the second map is a base change of the flat diagonal of Y over Z, and concludes with the cited Morphisms-chapter lemmas that flatness is stable under base change and composition; part (2) adds the unramified half, which is Morphisms, lemma-unramified-composition, and the definition of weakly etale. Retained author proof at lines 18984-18999.
